list_appointments.description:
List appointments for a location

The appointment connection supports queries on the following fields:

* id: Id
* startAt: DateTime
* createdAt: DateTime
* cancelled: Boolean
* staffId: Id
list_appointments.name: list_appointments

list_clients.description:
List Clients for a business.

The Client connection supports queries on the following fields:

* id: Id
* email: String
* name: String
* mobilePhone: String
* active: Boolean
* externalId: String
* primaryLocation: Id
* createdAt: DateTime, in UTC timezone (Z or +0000 suffix)
* updatedAt: DateTime, in UTC timezone (Z or +0000 suffix)

Apart from currently supported query parameters we also introduce two custom filters:
* emails: list_of(String)
* clientIds: list_of(Id)
list_clients.name: list_clients

list_orders.description:
List Orders for a location.

The Order connection supports queries on the following fields:

* id: ID
* clientId: ID
* closedAt: DateTime
* updatedAt: DateTime
* createdAt: DateTime
list_orders.name: list_orders

list_products.description:
List products for a business

The Product connection supports queries on the following fields:

* id: ID
* categoryId: ID
* externalId: String
* sku: String. Matched on active inventory units.
* inventoryUnitId: ID. A ProductInventoryUnit global id.
list_products.name: list_products

parameters.description:
If false (default), shows only active products.
If true, shows only inactive products.
parameters.name: inactive

parameters.description:
If true (default), include package products.
If false, exclude package products.
parameters.name: include_packages

parameters.description:
If true (default), include membership plan products.
If false, exclude membership plan products.
parameters.name: include_plans

list_staff.description:
List Staff for a business

The Staff connection supports queries on the following fields:

* id: Id
* email: String
* name: String
* mobilePhone: String
* active: Boolean
list_staff.name: list_staff

list_tags.description:
List Tags for a business

Tags can be added to and removed from taggable entities via the addTag and removeTag mutations
list_tags.name: list_tags
